decisions.reason: Assigning get.lotclip.com to the landing page does not change the existing requirement that lotclip.com continue routing to the LOTCLIP product.
The selected landing-page hostname does not change the hero content, layout, action links, or mobile framing.
The hostname selection does not change the Webflow platform, website deliverable, or phase-one scope.
The domain-routing decision does not alter the landing page's visual style, brand inputs, design reference, or approved design option.
The selected hostname has no effect on the required bottom-section image.
The hostname selection does not change the form's fields, recipients, audience, comment box, or follow-up behavior.
The domain-routing decision does not modify the contact-page copy or headline.
